title: redact keeps a URL password or a Bearer credential that is $ and word characters, taking it for a $NAME placeholder
goal: redact replaces a URL user:password@ password that is $ followed by word characters; redact replaces an Authorization Bearer or Basic credential that is $ followed by word characters; redact replaces a secret assignment's value that is $ followed by word characters; ${NAME}, <...>, %NAME% and *** stay as placeholders in those places; kb/_self/querylog.md no longer lists $NAME among the values that stay

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="$Fake"+"Pass12345x";o=R.redact("https://user:"+v+"@db.example.com");print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="Fake"+"Pass12345x";b=chr(92)+chr(34);K="pass"+"word=";o=R.redact("Authorization: Bearer $"+v);print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="Fake"+"Pass12345x";b=chr(92)+chr(34);K="pass"+"word=";o=R.redact(K+"$"+v);print(o);sys.exit(1 if v in o else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import redact as R;v="Fake"+"Pass12345x";b=chr(92)+chr(34);K="pass"+"word=";k=["Authorization: Bearer ${API_KEY}","https://user:<secret>@db.example.com",K+"%DBPASS%",K+"***"];c=[x for x in k if R.redact(x)!=x];o=R.redact("https://user:$"+v+"@db.example.com");print("changed:",c,o);sys.exit(1 if c or v in o else 0)

import sys;t=open("kb/_self/querylog.md",encoding="utf-8").read();l=[x for x in t.splitlines() if x.startswith("1. **Rules**")][0];print("$NAME listed:","`$NAME`" in l);sys.exit(1 if "`$NAME`" in l else 0)

gates.question: In a secret place (a URL user:password@ password, an Authorization Bearer or Basic credential, a secret assignment value), is a $ followed by word characters a placeholder that stays, or a value redact replaces?
options: replace every $word value there; keep ${NAME}, <...>, %NAME% and ***
keep an upper-case $NAME env reference there; replace a $word that holds a lower-case letter
